spec.prompt: Add a getPluginMeta(fn) export that returns the metadata fastify-plugin attached to a wrapped function (its options: name, fastify version, etc.), or undefined for a function that wasn't wrapped.
spec.requirement: fastify-plugin exports getPluginMeta(value) (as require('fastify-plugin').getPluginMeta). For a function returned by fastify-plugin it returns a shallow copy of the attached metadata (fn[Symbol.for('plugin-meta')]): mutating the result does not change the plugin. For any other value (unwrapped functions, objects, null, undefined) it returns undefined and never throws.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: getPluginMeta(fp(fn, { name: 'a', fastify: '5.x' })) has name 'a' and fastify '5.x'
auto-named plugins report their generated name
mutating the returned object does not change a later getPluginMeta result
unwrapped functions, null and undefined give undefined without throwing
